How the projection works. Each returning player and incoming transfer carries the points per set she actually produced in 2025, normalised to a neutral schedule using a measured level effect (-0.214 points per set per standard deviation of opponent strength, from 20,997 player-matches). A team’s six best are summed, and the result moves the team off its 2025 rating — which on its own predicts the following season at 0.86, and is too strong to throw away.

What it cannot see, and by how much. Freshmen count as zero, because no recruiting data is held and inventing a number is worse than admitting the gap. That gap is now measured rather than hand-waved: across 348 teams in 2025, players with no prior D-I record supplied a median 22% of their team's production, and for some teams far more — Hampton 94%, Vanderbilt 73%. So a team with a large incoming class is under-rated here by roughly that much. A red number beside a team name means we know fewer than six of its players.

Start typing, or click any team on the Rankings, Scores or Schedule tab to open it here.

Season leaders, per set rather than totals — totals just rank whoever has played most. A player needs 4 sets to qualify; that minimum rises with the season.

Hitting percentage needs at least 20 swings before it means anything, so a player below that shows an em dash rather than a number built on four attempts.

Conference tables, filling in as results land. Conference record first, overall beside it — early in a season nearly every match is non-conference, so the conference column stays empty for a while by nature.

Every part of this is soft. Conference champions are projected as each league’s highest-rated team, but most leagues award the bid by tournament, so it can go to anyone who wins it. The AQ mechanism is confirmed for only 6 of 32 conferences.

Seeding here is our order, not a committee’s. The committee seeds on resume — RPI, record against the top 25 and 50, head to head — and our field projector, which reproduced 62 of the actual 64 for 2025, needs played matches before it can run. It takes over once there are results.
